senses.definition: n.pr.m. 𝔊 Λωταν; a son of שֵׂעִיר Gn 36:20, 22 = 1 Ch 1:38, 39, and father of חֹרִי etc. Gn 36:22 = 1 Ch 1:39; called a chief (אַלּוּף) of הַחֹרִי Gn 36:29.
